status: DRAFT — prospective; NOT yet registered or executed; no CTT output is CERTIFIED
purpose: Scientific (inferential) certification of CTT reliability point estimates beyond numerical agreement.

estimands.alpha: population coefficient alpha of the raw total, Cronbach (1951)
estimands.kr20: alpha for 0/1 items (sample-variance convention; identical to alpha)
estimands.kr21: KR-21 of the raw total (equal-difficulty approximation; estimand KR-21 itself, not reliability)
estimands.omega_std: population omega_total of standardized items under a one-factor model (latent-variable reliability of the unit-weighted standardized sum)
estimands.omega_raw: population omega_total of the raw observed total under a one-factor model
estimands.sb_odd_even / guttman_l4_odd_even: population split-half coefficients for the fixed odd/even split
estimands.true_reliability: rho_XX' = var(T)/var(X) computed exactly from the generating model; reported for bias-versus-truth, not used as the gate for alpha/KR coefficients

designs.factors: N {200, 1000}; k {6, 20}; model {essentially tau-equivalent, congeneric (loadings .4-.8)}; item type {continuous normal, 5-category polytomous, binary 2PL}; missingness {none, MCAR 10%}
designs.truth: population coefficient computed exactly from the generating covariance (continuous) or by 10^6-draw population simulation fixed before the study (categorical)

replications.unit: dataset (cluster); all coefficients from one dataset share the cluster
replications.mcse: cluster-robust MCSE of bias and RMSE; required MCSE(bias) <= .002 per cell
replications.feasibility: closed-form coefficients ~1 ms/dataset; ML omega ~5 ms; 48000 datasets < 10 CPU-min

seeds.independence: disjoint from every development seed; development may use root 20261126014 only

gates.bias_vs_population_coefficient: |mean(est) - population coefficient| <= .01 for N=1000 and <= .02 for N=200, in every cell where the estimand is defined
gates.omega_heywood_refusal: refusal (None) rate reported; refusal must not exceed .05 in congeneric continuous cells
gates.missing: MCAR cells: complete-case estimates must meet the same bias gates; effective N (complete cases) reported; MAR not in scope (complete-case analysis not claimed unbiased under MAR)
gates.categorical: for polytomous/binary items the Pearson-based omega estimand is the observed-score omega of the Pearson covariance; no claim about latent-response (categorical) omega
gates.simultaneity: a coefficient is certified only if it passes in all cells of its applicable design; failures archived; no post-hoc cell removal

not_in_scope: standard errors and confidence intervals of reliability coefficients
numerical_prerequisites: validation/evidence/ctt_reference/COMPARISON.json (psych/lavaan agreement) must pass on the registered commit
